title: Custom Skirmish Trails language file
description: Optional text overrides for one trail in one game language.

trail_title.description: Translated title under the trail button; omit or leave empty to keep the original title.

trail_summary.description: Translated summary under the trail title; omit or leave empty to keep the original summary.

mission_locked_text.description: Translated briefing for a dated scenario that has yet to open, with {date} filled in; omit or leave empty to keep the original text.

missions.description: Translations keyed by mission number as text, starting at "1", or by node id when the trail's route names its missions by file; omission keeps the original mission text.

^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.description: Translations for this mission (number or node id); omitted entries keep their original text.

mission_name.description: Translated mission title in the briefing; omission keeps the original title.

text_description_line_01.description: Translated briefing line 1; omission keeps the original line.

text_description_line_02.description: Translated briefing line 2; omission keeps the original line.

text_description_line_03.description: Translated briefing line 3; omission keeps the original line.

text_description_line_04.description: Translated briefing line 4; omission keeps the original line.

text_description_line_05.description: Translated briefing line 5; omission keeps the original line.

text_description_line_06.description: Translated briefing line 6; omission keeps the original line.

text_description_line_07.description: Translated briefing line 7; omission keeps the original line.

text_description_line_08.description: Translated briefing line 8; omission keeps the original line.

player1_name.description: Translated name for the human player in the briefing and game; omission keeps the original name.

player2_name.description: Translated name for player 2 in the briefing and game; omission keeps the original name.

player3_name.description: Translated name for player 3 in the briefing and game; omission keeps the original name.

player4_name.description: Translated name for player 4 in the briefing and game; omission keeps the original name.

player5_name.description: Translated name for player 5 in the briefing and game; omission keeps the original name.

player6_name.description: Translated name for player 6 in the briefing and game; omission keeps the original name.

player7_name.description: Translated name for player 7 in the briefing and game; omission keeps the original name.

player8_name.description: Translated name for player 8 in the briefing and game; omission keeps the original name.

scenario_briefing.description: Translated briefing text of a scenario mission, shown instead of the map's own description; omission keeps the original text.
